description: Gold-blind Stage 3 development inference pack shared by Winter (S3.4), Sun (S3.5) and the non-LLM baselines (S3.6). Contains ONLY the fields a runner needs: item_id/process_id/rule_id/rule_text and, for violation check points, an explicit check_type (missing_action | incorrect_actor | out_of_order). check_type is routing metadata of the frozen test point, NOT a Gold label. The pack never carries decision_*, candidate_*, evidence, or any human adjudication. It is generated deterministically from the frozen blank pack (sorted by item_id); shuffling the source order must not change the generated pack.

matching_items.description: 25 rule-process relevance items; only inference fields

violation_items.description: 33 violation check points; check_type is the routing metadata
